sealed_record.thesis: The HBM buildout is cannibalizing commodity DRAM (DDR5, LPDDR5X) capacity, and the shortage is now spreading from HBM into commodity memory — power has shifted decisively from set-makers to memory manufacturers, ending Big Tech's cheap-panel/cheap-memory workaround. jukan05 and aleabitoreddit converge on structural, accelerating memory demand (hyperscaler LTAs with SanDisk/SNDK, Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron) driven by AI capex, with the key tell being accelerating revenue/EPS in line with hyperscaler capex rather than sentiment. SNDK is a direct beneficiary of the commodity-memory shortage spillover and is not blocklisted (unlike SKHY). Long the structural memory-shortage leg.

outcome.thesis_note: DITUTUP -45.4%. Ditutup dalam AI trade unwind: skandal dan pencopotan Jensen Huang (8 Nov), aturan sementara ekspor chip AI dari Departemen Perdagangan AS (16 Nov). Long AI/semikonduktor 0 dari 12 untung.
